rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches codebase conventions, correctly utilizes existing HTTP/API patterns and error handling idioms.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409 conflict test lookups, conditional archive uploads, and meticulously maps abort reasons to specific API error codes.
rationale.scope: Strictly implements the requirement without unrelated changes; keeps legacy v1 and push-ref logic completely intact.
rationale.readability: Cleanly modularized into a new provisioning package; data structures and functions are very easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Solid retry loop in HTTPClient, prevents goroutine leaks with context polling, handles unmarshaling and pointers safely.
rationale.maintainability: Fake server is thorough and well-designed, enabling easy testing; nicely decouples clients and avoids tight coupling.
